tips.title: Hand over a goal, not a script
tips.body: Say what you want finished, where the materials are and what the result should look like. Let DeTars choose the steps.
tips.prompt: Compare these three products using real cases and original sources, and give me a comparison I can discuss with my team.

tips.title: 交代目标，别交代步骤
tips.body: 说清要完成什么、材料在哪、成品长什么样；怎么做交给 DeTars。
tips.prompt: 根据真实案例和原始来源比较这三款产品，给我一份能和团队讨论的对比。

tips.title: Keep what this project taught you
tips.body: Turn useful results into linked notes on your computer, ready to find and reuse next time.
tips.prompt: Put the three things most worth keeping from this project into my notes, and link them to my earlier notes on customer interviews.

tips.title: 把成果留下，变成自己的知识
tips.body: 让项目里值得留的结论变成电脑上的笔记，连到旧知识，下次还能接着用。
tips.prompt: 把这个项目里最值得保留的三点放进我的笔记，连到以前关于客户访谈的记录。

tips.title: You can correct its memory
tips.body: If a preference changes or DeTars remembers something wrong, say so and ask it to update the old record.
tips.prompt: My preference has changed. Help me update the old record and make clear where the new preference applies.

tips.title: 记错了，直接告诉它
tips.body: 偏好变了、记忆不对了，就让 DeTars 修正旧记录，不必每次重新解释。
tips.prompt: 我的偏好变了，帮我更新旧记录，并说清新偏好适用于哪些场合。

tips.title: Turn a good method into a Skill
tips.body: Weekly report templates and review checklists can become reusable Skills attached to a project.
tips.prompt: Look through these tasks, pick the most useful repeatable method, and turn it into a Skill for this project.

tips.title: 好方法可以变成 Skill
tips.body: 周报模板、方案结构、审阅清单都能保存成 Skill，挂到项目上重复用。
tips.prompt: 看看这些任务，选出最值得复用的一套方法，整理成这个项目的 Skill。

tips.title: Ask why you decided last time
tips.body: You do not need to remember which conversation held a decision. Ask DeTars to find the original record.
tips.prompt: Why did we drop that approach last time? Find the original discussion and explain the reasons.

tips.title: 忘了上次为什么？问它
tips.body: 不用记住结论藏在哪段对话里，让 DeTars 找回当时的原始记录。
tips.prompt: 上次为什么放弃那个方案？找回原始讨论，帮我回顾当时的理由。

tips.title: Keep a question under review
tips.body: Some questions deserve another look as facts change. Ask for a regular review and the signals worth watching.
tips.prompt: Review this research every month with fresh sources, and tell me when evidence changes the main conclusions.

tips.title: 值得追的问题，持续追下去
tips.body: 有些结论会随事实变化。交代复查节奏，也让它留意哪些信号值得再看。
tips.prompt: 每月用新来源复查这份研究，有证据改变主要结论时告诉我。

tips.title: Your team can reach you away from the desk
tips.body: With an IM channel such as Feishu or Telegram connected, the Chief of Staff can bring you results and decisions.
tips.prompt: Help me connect an IM channel so the Chief of Staff can reach me with project results and decisions when I am away.

tips.title: 离开电脑，也能接到进展
tips.body: 连上飞书或 Telegram 等 IM，幕僚长就能在你不在电脑前时带来成果和待决事项。
tips.prompt: 帮我连接一个 IM 渠道，让幕僚长在我离开电脑时也能把项目成果和待决事项发给我。

tips.title: Let replies speak when you do
tips.body: Voice replies can be always on, or respond aloud only when you speak. Longer replies can stay text-only.
tips.prompt: Set Chat voice replies to When I speak, and keep replies over 500 characters text-only.

tips.title: 你说话时，它也用声音回答
tips.body: 语音回复可以始终开启，也可以只在你说话时开启；长回复仍用文字。
tips.prompt: 把 Chat 的语音回复改成“我说话时”，超过 500 字只发文字。

tips.title: Give specialist work a specialist canvas
tips.body: Use Cowork for multi-step work, and a matching Pack when you need its specialist methods and canvas.
tips.prompt: I want to trace where this claim comes from. Help me start in Content Research and check the original sources.

tips.title: 专业的活，交给专业画布
tips.body: 多步骤的工作放进 Cowork；需要专门方法和画布时，交给对应的 Pack。
tips.prompt: 我想追查这个说法从哪里来，帮我在内容调研里开始，核对原始来源。

tips.title: Set Auto privacy before the first message
tips.body: For other people's private details, enable Auto privacy when creating a Cowork task. Text inside images is not masked.
tips.prompt: Explain how to start a Cowork task with Auto privacy for client files, and which details it cannot mask.

tips.title: 涉及他人隐私，开工前先开保护
tips.body: 新建 Cowork 任务时可打开自动隐私；首条消息发出后开关锁定，图片里的文字不会脱敏。
tips.prompt: 告诉我怎样为客户文件新建开启自动隐私的 Cowork 任务，以及哪些内容无法脱敏。
